title: Novel Characterizations of the m-Generalized Group Inverse
content: We study the m-generalized group inverse of Banach elements and establish several new properties. The main result is a novel characterization via the right hybrid (b,c)-inverse, revealing an intrinsic link between the two notions. Additive properties and image-based characterizations are also derived. These results extend the theory of the m-weak group inverse to a broader class of Banach elements and shed new light on infinite-dimensional operators.
